Module 04 · Sheet 1/3 · 14 states in this module · 390 × 844 mobile frames
Upgrade requires Gold and copies; Gems never silently substitute. Deck selection validates eight unique cards. Power and reward gates are configurable.
Numbered controls match the route rail beside each phone. Arrows lead to destination screen IDs. Dashed paths are system outcomes, not player buttons.
Selecting a collection card opens its detail; deck edit uses explicit replace slot. Upgrade badges
Show present and next-level stats, copies and Gold requirement before purchase. Upgrade CTA blocked
Insufficient Gold → W04 / Insufficient copies → D07
Deduct Gold and copies atomically; increment card level once. Client refreshes on stale inventory
